notes.title: Week #45 Update
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOxfjCQMrFoLexwFq/giphy.gif 

Hello there!

This week there is LOTS. We are very close to the release.

 2 new levels 

Let’s start with the two remaining locations for the launch version of the game, Motor Bay and Golden Sands! 

Motor Bay is dense urban map with lots of side streets, drainage canals and factories. Also included some train tracks that might or might not be clever to use! This is probably the hardest map in the game.

Golden Sands is a small casino city with very level design, so not much bumps here! Traffic is pretty heavy though on the main streets so good tip is to use the smaller side streets for quicker routes!

 5 new cars 
 
- Isoville
- Camel
- Freak Bus
- Road King
- Wanderer

Road King and Wanderer are unlocked after completing Golden Sands and are both some of the best cars in the game.

 Other changes:
- Bugfixes and optimization
- Visuals improved on some of the maps
- New color grading for all the maps
- Arena is unlocked after completing Golden Sands

 What's next?

Both of the new maps are still bit work in progress but we are very VERY near the finish line here,biggest thing still to be added is the final soundtrack. Let us know how the new stuff works for you and have a blast playing Pako 2!

notes.title: Week 43 update
notes.content:
Some new stuff added, bugs fixed and visual polishing done this week! Now in the game over screen, player gets notified of next unlockable item and also gets info if there's something to buy in the shop areas with the updated amount of money. 

Just to remind you to check your crib (which btw can be found in Title menu > Progress) every now and then, we added a notifier in the title menu. :) It shows a small note if there's new furniture etc. gained.

Other things. "Extra life" perk felt too powerful so we removed it from the stack for now and added "Sidekick" perk instead. The new perk spawns a friendly helper car which joins the fight on your side.

Hi yall!

We decided to put one more level out separately, opposed to our original idea of releasing the rest as one update! This is Misty Fields, and it will be placed as the second area of the game, after Devils Plains. Misty Fields consists of a town in a crossing of two highways, and some more nature-oriented areas with frozen lake and falls, and a field that leads to a small pond. notes.title: Week 41 update
notes.content:
Hello fellow players! Latest patch's biggest changes include perk deck organizing and experience points, but that's not all. More info below! Remember in the "Early Access" things are always a bit experimental and under construction, so please share your opinions about the changes with us.

Change log:
* Added: experience points (XP). Experience points accumulate as player does robberies and purchases stuff in the garage and car shop.
* Change: maps are now unlocked with XP. If you had already unlocked a map, your XP is automatically granted to match that map's XP goal.
* Added "Perk deck". You can optionally use manual order for the perks that are rewarded in successful robberies. Perks unlock as usable with XP. Use "Title menu > Perk deck" to change order in the manual deck. Then choose "Perk deck: Manual" in the Stage selection screen to use manual order instead of default random system.
* Added a low camera angle
* Added a car "Whale"
* Modified the shooting mechanics to be more accurate in submachine weapons (submachine gun, minigun, assault rifle, front fire). Guns have also longer shooting range. 

https://i.imgur.com/E7riLo4.gif

notes.title: Week 39 update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/5329c2f5003a8cbda978293d5491c08bdc039cbd.jpg
News! Don't worry, we haven't forgotten you, just been quite busy with developing and testing the current game and some ideas, plus building the next levels that will be added in the future. :)
In today's patch there's a new car, perk items, and more.

Change log:
* Added a car: Bird
* Added an item: "Bomb squad". An explosion kills nearby enemies each time crew has been picked up.
* Added an item: "Shock". Electric shock is dealt to cop cars that bump into player
* Added an item: "Health Steal". You get sometimes +1HP when crashing a cop car
* Changed "Death Touch" item so that now it activates only when crashing with turbo speed
* Changed "Speed bonus" so it now rises if you manage to get the bonus multiple times in a row.
* Added civilian traffic into level Devil's Plains
* Added optional setting "Difficulty: Hard". In Hard mode, there's no item rewards but you get +10% money from the robberies.
* Optimization (incl. the guide arrow to the next target appears faster)
* Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Week 35 update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/f594dc4bbe54ed30b3d0e501862ae4bcc3c4f250.jpg
It's not even friday yet but the weekly patch is already available! 

The main news: tweaking of the difficulty level continues. Now the bumps to other cars and to the environment deals significantly less damage. Please share your opinion if the game actually feels more or less likeable and fun this way. :) 
There's also added a little timer for the getaways. You get a bonus if you manage to do your run in the given time. Don't worry too much if time runs out: you still get paid the regular reward like before. Like everything else, this too is still under development. 
Lastly, the third main addition is that car in the picture, "Heavy van". Go give it a ride.


Short version:
* Game is now a bit easier: Cars take less damage from environment bumps
* Added Speed Bonus Timer for getaways: Player gets +20% reward if arrives in destination in time
* Added car: "Heavy Van"
* Minor optimization
* Minor bug fixes

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/73a287e79ab3aac3a340274de578a2e88c9b8285.png

Other bigger additions are police stations scattered to maps (as seen in the pic above).  They spawn cop cars while being close by, so better try to avoid them bit! 

Oh, and to guarantee more destruction, we added flamethrower!

Here is the full list of changes:

* Passive perk items are moved from the Garage to in-game spawnables
* Performing robberies now randomly reward a perk item
* Added weapon: Flamethrower
* Added police stations
* Modified the level "Test Drive"
* Perk loading indicator added
* Minor changes in the weapon: Bazooka
* Minor bug fixes 
* GFX improvements on Devils Plains
* Garage menu GFX redone
* Added several perk items

As you know the drill, keep feedback coming and have fun playing the game! We are hard at work to bring you more content (as in levels, cars, etc), next level has been chosen and is taking its final touches quite fast.

All the best,

TMG

notes.title: Week 26 update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/a01ecc7f75a8aad885fcaab95f90886b579be36c.gif

This week we add a new level based on your wishes! It is smaller size arena type of level named...drumroll..Arena! It harkens back to first Pako's small survival based levels. Your goal is to survive as long as possible in level with no escape, and compete in leaderboards. This level and Test Drive can now be accessed from Main Menu -> Survival. We continue to tweak this level in the future and if feedback is good, we consider maybe making more of these to the side.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/86727e16ff6b29660789e223de96eb2606716067.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/00ec51cafd3f714babb9795f0a46895b02569fe5.png

In other additions there are tweaks to Devil's Plains, mainly to the rock quarry area that has been shrunk bit for easier access. Also to middle area of map we have added some more landmarks to make it easier to figure out what part of the map you are at.

Another navigation helper is that we added the target name to the guide arrow, this hopefully makes it easier to remember different places in the map.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/8eba44f2cbe917e6cb9a023f7085c72d24aed856.jpg

Also, we balanced the game to have more enemies but they are lot weaker than before, this making shooting more enjoyable. Also, now if your round ends to Busted, there is no penalty (BUT for escape you get a bonus)  so keep those long runs going!

Full set of changes:

* Added a survival level "Arena"
* Moved the "Test drive" level to survival levels
* Changed the order of main levels to Tutorial > Devil's Plains > Martin's Valley
* Busted penalty changed to Escape bonus
* Amount of enemies is increased
* Enemy hitpoints are decreased
* Added active target name into the guide arrow 
* Minor GFX improvements
* Minor bug fixes

We are happy to hear what you think of the new content so drop us a line here or Twitter!

notes.title: Week 24 update
notes.content:
Time for the weekly update! This week we mostly fixed bugs and kept tweaking Devils Plains. For example Quarry area of the map has been reworked for easier sense of navigation (and lots of things to destroy!). Also other additional improvements have been made all around the map and lighting has been slightly fixed.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/a2a32917adf12cee317dee881488174c0825439e.png

On new features, we added new ride, Wagon:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/185ec85b8a0f6216d5a4c9f3503482cf0cf0115c.png

Also, we now have online leaderboards included in in-game menus so you can keep track on your world rankings! 

Last but not least we added bit experimental feature of 2 player support! This works that way that player 1 steers the car normally (and can also shoot), but second player can shoot also if two gamepads have been included. If this is a feature you would like us to expand, we are happy to hear possible ideas.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28262084/3f80079e7063ab9342d33fbc0e848c41a19cc215.png

What's changed:
* Added partial 2-player support (Player2 can shoot while Player1 drives)
* Added online leaderboards to in-game menus
* Added new song 'Gamble'
* Added car "Wagon"
* Minor weapon tweaks
* GFX improvements
* Bug fixes

Give us a shout at the comment box!
Best regards, TMG

Perks include items such as 'extra life', 'helicopter resistant' and 'mechanic', the latter of which makes it possible to repair damage during gameplay. You can choose one perk at time.
As always, thanks for playing and please post your opinions on the changes and overall gameplay.

* Added visual info for hitpoint damage
* Falling from heights doesn't instakill anymore but gives -2HP damage
* Tutorial made easier: there's now always extra lives and checkpoints to respawn in the Tutorial level
* Minor improvements and bug fixes in UI

notes.title: Week 18 update
notes.content:
Plenty of the feedback has been notes about overall difficulty in surviving and gaining money, so these are the main things we have been working with lately.

WHAT'S CHANGED:
* Changed car "VAN" price to free and it's also set to default vehicle for the first boot. The van is slower and easier to drive and maybe more suitable for beginners.
* Helicopter is called much later, and it's no longer permanent but goes away after time limit. However, helicopter is called again in the next robbery.
* Cops spawn with more delay and don't have guns immediately
* Successful robberies now give +1 hitpoint
* Upgrades are slightly cheaper
* Cars can now take a bit harder impact damage without losing a hitpoint
* Robbery goal trigger size is increased
* Compass/guide arrow appears more quickly when picking up robbers
* Added support for windowed mode (Settings > Fullscreen)
* Minor fixes such as missing colliders etc.

notes.title: Some tips and Re: Feedback this far
notes.content:
Just some general tips for everybody playing:

1. Keep moving and know your location!

Learn the ins and outs of Martin's Valley stage! There is lots of shortcuts like jumps and some narrow paths to use. When you pick up people, they say the destination, and after that destination can be read from the HUD top left. Trying to memorize where the general locations are can be very handy. Compass shows the straight with green arrow, but it is up to you to figure out the best route there!

2. Upgrade your car to fit your play style!

Upgrades are very important. Maybe you want to play more like a tank and upgrade your weapons and armor, or maybe you want to have maximum boost ability to get out fast from tight spots. Keep in mind that every car also drives bit differently and some of them can be upgraded more on some areas than others.

3. Try to do long runs!

Every job you complete adds to a multiplier for your current round. 1-2 jobs done wont make much money, but getting around 10 jobs can make up to 15-16k $. This is something we will tweak, but generally longer the run, more money for you!

-----

Thank you also everybody for all the feedback. We have been fixing issues with aiming, menus and other things you have said. Keep em coming. Our aim is to update the game at some point this week, based on your feedback, some things we have noted ourselves and also adding more game content. 

Some teaser regarding new cars can be found on our Twitter, bit more agile, but still durable smaller van will probably be in your hands later this week.

-Heikki / TMG

Compass shows the straight with green arrow, but it is up to you to figure out the best route there!

2. Upgrade your car to fit your play style!

Upgrades are very important. Maybe you want to play more like a tank and upgrade your weapons and armor, or maybe you want to have maximum boost ability to get out fast from tight spots. Keep in mind that every car also drives bit differently and some of them can be upgraded more on some areas than others.

3. Try to do long runs!

Every job you complete adds to a multiplier for your current round. 1-2 jobs done wont make much money, but getting around 10 jobs can make up to 15-16k $. This is something we will tweak, but generally longer the run, more money for you!
